summary: Monthly full-platform regression (Iteration 514). 18/18 backend pytest cases PASS covering: auth login, properties, portfolio-report, reviews list, booking-widget book, public survey, public photo-contest + IP-protected vote (429 on duplicate), GDPR erasure, ProfitPricing matrix, ProfitPricing autopilot run, DecisionAssurance /aldgate-flats (120d), DataQuality per-property (health_score + issues), DataQuality summary/all (avg_score + properties), RevPAM (>=2 spaces), ABS public (5 attrs w/ image_url), Group Displacement analyze (rooms_requested 60 @ 70 -> new net fields), and Group Sales OS full lifecycle (create RFP 'Regresyon QA Grubu' -> quote v1 -> reschedule -> quote v2 -> won -> block.action='created' + bookings doc room_type='Group Block' status=confirmed + booking_ref returned -> RFP email returns status='mock' -> lost -> block.action='released' + booking cancelled). Frontend smoke: admin login, dashboard renders DataHealthStrip with dhs-chip-default (score 55, Franziskaner by Centra), and all 8 command-palette destinations (profit-pricing, data-quality, group-sales, decision-assurance, revpam, abs-selling, ai-reply-robot, calendar) render non-blank with 0 error boundaries and 0 pageerrors. Public /book/default flow works: search -> Reserve -> ABS section with 5 abs-attr-* cards (Deniz manzarası flagged 'Popüler') -> click adds abs-line, total £200 -> £230 (+£30) -> Pay-at-Property selectable + Complete Booking button visible.

issues: Radix a11y warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' still present from prior iteration — a11y minor.

All 0 error boundaries.

action_items: (Optional) A11y: add aria-describedby to command-palette Radix DialogContent to silence console warning (carried over from iter 511).
critical_code_review_comments: group_sales.update_rfp reschedule/quote chain: when status=won -> lost, the code cancels the booking but does NOT $unset block_booking_id/ref — but on won->new/quoted/negotiating path it does $unset. Slight inconsistency: after status=lost, block_booking_id stays on the RFP with a cancelled booking. If a user then moves lost->won again, the guard `not rfp.get('block_booking_id')` prevents creating a new booking, potentially leaving the RFP in a state where the linked booking is cancelled but no new one is created. Suggest also $unset block_booking_id/ref on the 'lost' branch (or re-open the cancelled booking).

profit_pricing autopilot loop and data_quality_sentinel_loop are background workers — no test coverage for their failure/recovery paths; consider adding a lightweight healthcheck endpoint that exposes last_run_at + last_error.
GDPR erasure returns 200 with affected={} even when nothing matched (silent no-op). Consider surfacing 'not_found' hint so admins can distinguish 'redacted 0 rows' from 'user never existed'.
seed_data_creation: Created one RFP 'Regresyon QA Grubu' on property 'default'; ended in status='lost' with block released (booking cancelled). Existing 'Beta Kongre' RFP untouched.
